topic: The Physics of Pi: Colliding Blocks and Digit Emergence
target_audience: University students with a background in introductory physics (mechanics)

sections.title: The Hook: A Surprising Connection
lecture_lines: Collisions between two blocks can compute Pi.
Small mass m hits large mass M.
M is much larger than m.
A wall reflects the small block back.
animations: Display text "Pi from Collisions" in light color #FF00FF.
Animate two blocks of size m and M (m << M) at #00FF00.
Show block m moving toward block M at #FFFF00.
Show block m colliding with block M at #FF0000.

sections.title: Prerequisite Physics: Conservation Laws
lecture_lines: Elastic collisions conserve both momentum and energy.
Conservation laws dictate the resulting velocity.
[Asset: VelocityVectors] show energy transfer between blocks.
animations: Fade in two blocks labeled m and M in blue #0000FF.
Show collision between m and M with flash #FF0000.

sections.title: Visualizing Phase Space
lecture_lines: We map velocities into a 2D plane.
Each collision is a reflection in phase space.
animations: Fade in 2D axes with labels v_m and v_M in #FFFFFF.
Place a point P at (v_m, v_M) in green #00FF00.
Animate P reflecting across lines based on conservation laws.

sections.title: The Geometric Bridge to Pi
lecture_lines: Collisions equate to reflections in a wedge.
Trajectory follows an arc in the wedge.
The angle depends on the mass ratio.
More bounces reveal more digits of Pi.
animations: Draw a wedge with angle theta in white #FFFFFF.
Show block trajectory as an arc within the wedge.
Highlight angle theta as it narrows based on mass ratio.
Increase density of bounces as m/M decreases.
Overlay generated digits of Pi at the top #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Limit of Mass Ratios
lecture_lines: Exponential mass ratios yield digits of Pi.
Physics and geometry converge here beautifully.
animations: Display ratio M/m = 100^n for n=0, 1, 2 in #FFFFFF.
Animate convergence of trajectory toward a smooth arc.
Display final Pi value in yellow #FFFF00.
